description: parse_csv_line(line) splits one line of CSV text into a list of field strings. Fields are separated by commas. A field that STARTS with a double quote is a quoted field: it ends at the next double quote that is not doubled; commas inside it are ordinary characters and a doubled quote ("") stands for one literal quote. A closing quote must be followed by a comma or the end of the line, otherwise raise ValueError; a quoted field that never closes also raises ValueError. Quote characters in the middle of an unquoted field are ordinary characters. Spaces are never trimmed. An empty line gives [''], and a trailing comma gives a final empty field.
